newsitem.title: UK: ITV announces Christmas programme schedule.
newsitem.headline: ITV announces Christmas programme schedule.

text.p: ITV unveiled its schedule of Christmas programmes at a press conference on Tuesday and announced that it is ready to do battle with the BBC for audience share over the festive period.

ITV Network director Marcus Plantin said that the BBC has a "heavyweight" schedule including Hollywood blockbuster "Jurassic Park" and well-established comedy programmes such as "Only Fools and Horses", but he added "Our strategy is to get back to good old fashioned Christmas entertainment for all the family which will feature comedy and music."
The BBC traditionally dominates audience viewing figures for Christmas Day (December 25) but Plantin said that this year ITV has a new weapon in the ratings war -- the Royal Navy.
The network will be showing five live programmes from HMS Belfast, moored on the Thames and hosted by celebrity Anthea Turner.

Plantin said that "Christmas with the Royal Navy" will give viewers a behind-the- scenes look at Navy life and will include live links to naval ships off Croatia, in the Caribbean and in the Falkland Islands.

Other programmes in the ITV schedule include special Christmas editions of soap opera "Coronation Street" and the TV premiere of the Oscar-nominated film "The Remains of the Day" starring Anthony Hopkins and Emma Thompson.
A spokeswoman for the BBC said it will reveal its own Christmas line up shortly.
